name: Graham Hesele
source:
He is an old man who is the founder of KOKON. While he is leading an organization that is willing to conduct inhumane research, he himself is a good person. 
[spoiler]He has the power to see “something” in others that ordinary people cannot see, and in order to find out the meaning of this power, he gathered those who have that “something” and created the KOKON.[/spoiler]
